subject: Re: Kickoff: compositional-generalization recipe card
body:
Hi both,

Sweep status: harness is fully off the notebooks (thanks Fumiko) and the first pass over the grid is done. Headline findings match the paper: relative position encodings plus a copy decoder are the difference-makers — COGS exact-match jumps from the mid-30s to low-80s with the right combination, and the SCAN length splits show the same shape. The synthetic tasks (Addition, AdditionNegatives, Reversing, Duplication) are useful smoke tests: any config that fails Reversing fails everything compositional.

Trade-off surfacing for the recipe card: the best COGS config is not the best CFQ config — weight sharing helps small-data compositional splits but costs capacity on CFQ. The card probably needs two profiles rather than one default.

Risk: repetition variance is high on PCFG; single-run conclusions there are unsafe, which is exactly why Wei's July matrix matters.

Carmen
